insight: Develops the open-source Fish Speech / OpenAudio text-to-speech models alongside its proprietary hosted platform.
name: Fish Audio
tagline: Expressive, emotionally controllable text-to-speech, voice cloning, and voice agents.
description: Fish Audio is a voice AI platform for real-time text-to-speech with emotion tags, voice cloning from clips as short as 15 seconds, speech-to-text, and end-to-end voice agents. Its flagship S2 model targets natural, expressive, multilingual narration, and the company maintains the open-source Fish Speech (OpenAudio) models on GitHub. A free tier covers personal use, with paid plans and an API for commercial use.

modelSupport.notes: Runs Fish Audio's own S2 / Fish Speech models; not user-swappable.

edge: Open-weight models plus a hosted API at a fraction of ElevenLabs' price, with emotion-tagged speech and 15-second voice cloning.
pros: Fast voice cloning from ~15s of audio
cons: Free tier has monthly generation caps
